# Argument: zin_arg_value.
zin_elves_add_kinship = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_elves_kinship = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_kinship min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Argument: zin_arg_value. Cold Roads begins at 50 and ends below 40 (section 5.1).
zin_elves_add_wall_grievance = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_elves_wall_grievance = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_wall_grievance min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_wall_grievance value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_cold_roads }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_elves_cold_roads
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y0L }
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_elves_is_wall_realm = yes }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = Y0L modifier = zin_opinion_cold_roads }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_wall_grievance value = 40 compare = less_than }
			has_global_flag = zin_elves_cold_roads
		}
		clr_global_flag = zin_elves_cold_roads
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y0L }
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_elves_is_wall_realm = yes }
				remove_opinion_modifier = { target = Y0L modifier = zin_opinion_cold_roads }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: country. Argument: zin_arg_target (a country).
zin_elves_goodwill = {
	add_opinion_modifier = { target = var:zin_arg_target modifier = zin_opinion_elven_goodwill }
	reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = var:zin_arg_target modifier = zin_opinion_elven_goodwill }
}

# Scope: country. The Refusal spirit follows zin_refusal_lifted (section 4.1).
zin_elves_sync_refusal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_refusal_lifted
			has_idea = zin_elves_the_old_refusal
		}
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = zin_elves_the_old_refusal add_idea = zin_elves_refusal_set_aside }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_refusal_lifted }
			has_idea = zin_elves_refusal_set_aside
		}
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = zin_elves_refusal_set_aside add_idea = zin_elves_the_old_refusal }
	}
}

# The High Passes follow the watch (the mirror is set by zin_elves_add_pass_watch).
zin_elves_refresh_passes = {
	every_state = {
		limit = { zin_is_site_nolorim_passes = yes }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_elves_high_passes }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_elves_high_passes_2 }
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { original_tag = Y0X } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_pass_watch_mirror value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_elves_high_passes_2 }
			}
			else = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_elves_high_passes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Forts only rise: one level for every 20 points of watch, up to level 5 (section 7).
zin_elves_raise_pass_forts = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_level = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_cut = 20 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_pass_watch_mirror value = zin_elves_t_cut compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = zin_elves_t_level value = 5 compare = less_than }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_level = 1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_cut = 20 }
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_pass_fort_level value = zin_elves_t_level compare = less_than } }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_elves_pass_fort_level = 1 }
		every_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_nolorim_passes = yes }
			add_building_construction = {
				type = bunker
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
				province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_border = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	zin_elves_refresh_passes = yes
}

# Argument: zin_arg_value. A no-op when Nolorim does not exist (section 7).
zin_elves_add_pass_watch = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0X }
		Y0X = {
			add_to_variable = { zin_elves_pass_watch = zin_arg_value }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_elves_pass_watch min = 0 max = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_watch = zin_elves_pass_watch }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_elves_pass_watch_mirror = zin_elves_t_watch }
		zin_elves_raise_pass_forts = yes
	}
}

# Scope: the leader. Section 3.2.
zin_elves_raise_kindred = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed } }
		create_faction_from_template = zin_faction_kindred
		set_country_flag = zin_elves_kindred_leader
		set_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed
		set_global_flag = { flag = zin_elves_kindred_recent_war days = 730 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_kindred_leader }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_elves.31 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				OR = {
					zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
					tag = Y0L
				}
			}
			news_event = { id = zin_elves.32 }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: an elven realm. The option "Stand with the kin" as an effect (also called by the regional trees).
zin_elves_join_kindred = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed
			zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
			NOT = { zin_elves_in_kindred = yes }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_elves_joining_tmp
		random_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_kindred_leader }
			add_to_faction = PREV
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_elves_in_kindred = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_joining_tmp }
			}
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_kindred }
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_kindred }
		}
		clr_country_flag = zin_elves_joining_tmp
		zin_elves_join_kin_defence = yes
	}
}

# Elves helping elves: members join the war of a member whose state a foreign hand holds (section 3.2).
zin_elves_join_kin_defence = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_elves_in_kindred = yes
			zin_elves_realm_occupied = yes
		}
		save_event_target_as = zin_elves_defended
		every_enemy_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes }
				any_controlled_state = { is_owned_by = event_target:zin_elves_defended }
			}
			save_event_target_as = zin_elves_foe
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_elves_in_kindred = yes
					NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_elves_foe }
				}
				add_to_war = {
					targeted_alliance = event_target:zin_elves_defended
					enemy = event_target:zin_elves_foe
					hostility_reason = asked_to_join
					single_target_only = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Monthly: defence, and dissolution 730 days after the last war ends (section 3.2).
zin_elves_kindred_upkeep = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					zin_elves_in_kindred = yes
					zin_elves_realm_occupied = yes
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = { flag = zin_elves_kindred_recent_war days = 730 }
		}
		zin_elves_join_kin_defence = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_recent_war } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_elves_in_kindred = yes }
				every_country = {
					limit = { zin_elves_in_kindred = yes }
					remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_kindred }
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_kindred_leader }
				dismantle_faction = yes
				clr_country_flag = zin_elves_kindred_leader
			}
			clr_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Argument: zin_arg_attacker (Herrodon or Andos Enda). The feud decision effect; also called by their focuses behind the same gates (section 6). The cause of war is the claimed state, so no state id is needed in script.
zin_elves_begin_feud = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_feud }
			zin_elves_date_feud = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_elves_feud
		var:zin_arg_attacker = { save_event_target_as = zin_elves_feud_attacker }
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:zin_elves_feud_attacker = { original_tag = Y0W } }
			Y0V = {
				save_event_target_as = zin_elves_feud_rival
				random_owned_state = {
					limit = { zin_is_site_boundary_groves = yes }
					save_event_target_as = zin_elves_feud_state
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			Y0W = {
				save_event_target_as = zin_elves_feud_rival
				random_owned_state = { save_event_target_as = zin_elves_feud_state }
			}
		}
		event_target:zin_elves_feud_attacker = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_elves_feud_rival modifier = zin_opinion_feud_of_groves }
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_elves_feud_rival modifier = zin_opinion_feud_of_groves }
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_elves_feud_state }
				event_target:zin_elves_feud_state = { add_claim_by = event_target:zin_elves_feud_attacker }
				create_wargoal = {
					type = take_claimed_state
					target = event_target:zin_elves_feud_rival
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_elves.25 days = 365 }
		}
		event_target:zin_elves_feud_rival = { country_event = { id = zin_elves.25 days = 365 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -20 }
		zin_elves_add_kinship = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 2 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
			}
			news_event = { id = zin_elves.24 }
		}
	}
}

# The roads are closed; the Accord is not broken (section 5.1).
zin_elves_close_wall_roads = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_wall_roads_closed } }
		set_global_flag = zin_elves_wall_roads_closed
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_elves_is_wall_realm = yes }
			add_ideas = zin_elves_wall_roads_shut
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = Y0L }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = Y0L modifier = zin_opinion_wall_roads_closed }
				reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = Y0L modifier = zin_opinion_wall_roads_closed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = Y0P }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = Y0P modifier = zin_opinion_wall_roads_closed }
				reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = Y0P modifier = zin_opinion_wall_roads_closed }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				OR = {
					zin_elves_is_wall_realm = yes
					tag = Y0L
					tag = Y0P
				}
			}
			news_event = { id = zin_elves.10 }
		}
	}
}

# Reopening clears the flag, the idea and the opinions.
zin_elves_reopen_wall_roads = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_wall_roads_closed }
		clr_global_flag = zin_elves_wall_roads_closed
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_elves_is_wall_realm = yes }
			remove_ideas = zin_elves_wall_roads_shut
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = Y0L }
				remove_opinion_modifier = { target = Y0L modifier = zin_opinion_wall_roads_closed }
				Y0L = { remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_wall_roads_closed } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = Y0P }
				remove_opinion_modifier = { target = Y0P modifier = zin_opinion_wall_roads_closed }
				Y0P = { remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_wall_roads_closed } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: the Magical Forest. Right of passage for Aenor, its subjects and Kingson (section 5.5); never lifts the Refusal.
zin_elves_open_gates = {
	set_country_flag = zin_elves_gates_open
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0L }
		give_military_access = Y0L
		Y0L = {
			every_subject_country = { give_military_access = PREV }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_target = Y0L }
		zin_elves_goodwill = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0P }
		give_military_access = Y0P
	}
}

# Scope: the Magical Forest. Ends the access and steadies the woods for 180 days.
zin_elves_bar_gates = {
	clr_country_flag = zin_elves_gates_open
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0L }
		diplomatic_relation = { country = Y0L relation = military_access active = no }
		Y0L = {
			every_subject_country = { diplomatic_relation = { country = PREV relation = military_access active = no } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0P }
		diplomatic_relation = { country = Y0P relation = military_access active = no }
	}
	add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_elves_gates_barred days = 180 }
}

# Scope: a pilgrim-road realm. Argument: zin_arg_value (0 closed, 1 toll, 2 open). Section 10.
zin_elves_set_pilgrim_roads = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_was = zin_elves_pilgrim_roads }
	set_variable = { zin_elves_pilgrim_roads = zin_arg_value }
	set_variable = { zin_elves_pilgrim_months = 0 }
	remove_ideas = zin_elves_pilgrim_roads_open
	remove_ideas = zin_elves_pilgrim_tolls
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y8G }
		Y8G = {
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_pilgrim_tolls }
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_pilgrim_roads_closed }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_arg_value value = 2 compare = equals } }
		add_ideas = zin_elves_pilgrim_roads_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_arg_value value = 1 compare = equals } }
		add_ideas = zin_elves_pilgrim_tolls
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y8G }
			Y8G = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_pilgrim_tolls } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_arg_value value = 0 compare = equals } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y8G }
			Y8G = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_opinion_pilgrim_roads_closed } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_elves_t_was value = 0 compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -1 }
			zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a sender. A mission holds a timed slot flag as long as its idea lasts.

	set_variable = { zin_elves_wanderers_out = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_mission_a } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_wanderers_out = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_mission_b } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_wanderers_out = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_mission_c } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_wanderers_out = 1 } }
}

# Scope: an elven realm. The costs the focuses change; refreshed each month and at the start (a focus flag shows within a month).
zin_elves_refresh_costs = {
	set_variable = { zin_elves_cost_healers = 35 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_healers } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_cost_healers = -15 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_wanderers_extra } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_cost_healers = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_gala_friends_not_allies } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_cost_healers = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_free_wanderers } set_variable = { zin_elves_cost_healers = 0 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_elves_cost_healers min = 0 max = 99 }
	set_variable = { zin_elves_cost_wardens = 50 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_healers } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_cost_wardens = -15 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_wanderers_extra } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_cost_wardens = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_gala_friends_not_allies } add_to_variable = { zin_elves_cost_wardens = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_free_wanderers } set_variable = { zin_elves_cost_wardens = 0 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_elves_cost_wardens min = 0 max = 99 }
	set_variable = { zin_elves_cost_wall_moot = 50 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_wall_moot } set_variable = { zin_elves_cost_wall_moot = 25 } }
	set_variable = { zin_elves_cost_kindred = 75 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion } set_variable = { zin_elves_cost_kindred = 0 } }
}

# A dragon was bound by corruption: called once per dragon by zin_world.50, or by the monthly count (section 8).
zin_elves_on_dragon_corrupted = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_elves_corruptions_seen = 1 }
	set_global_flag = zin_elves_roost_sickness
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -20 }
	zin_elves_add_roost_bond = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_world_is_dragon_keeper = yes }
		country_event = { id = zin_elves.45 }
	}
}

# Scope: the taker. A Dragon Pact by focus: pool -1, Pact +1, bond -10 once (section 8).
zin_elves_focus_dragon_pact = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_dragons_free value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = zin_world_dragon_pacts value = 3 compare = less_than }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = THIS }
		zin_world_give_dragon = yes
		add_to_variable = { zin_world_dragon_pacts = 1 }
		set_country_flag = zin_war_dragon_pact
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_elves_pacts_seen = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
		zin_elves_add_roost_bond = yes
	}
}

	}
}

# Section 11: the Kindred becomes ready, the passes fill with wardens, the woods stand. Guarded by zin_elves_invasion_answered.
zin_elves_on_eastern_invasion = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_invasion_answered } }
		set_global_flag = zin_elves_invasion_answered
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
					tag = Y0L
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_elves.70 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 15 }
		zin_elves_add_kinship = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 20 }
		zin_elves_add_pass_watch = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
				has_war = yes
				any_enemy_country = { capital_scope = { zin_is_region_east_lands = yes } }
			}
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_elves_woods_defended days = 45 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y0L }
			Y0L = { country_event = { id = zin_elves.71 days = 3 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y0P }
			Y0P = { country_event = { id = zin_elves.71 days = 3 } }
		}
	}
}

# Once per war: every pass state is in foreign hands (section 7).
zin_elves_check_passes_lost = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_state = { zin_is_site_nolorim_passes = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_passes_lost_seen }
				NOT = {
					any_state = {
						zin_is_site_nolorim_passes = yes
						controller = { zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_elves_passes_lost_seen
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
			zin_elves_add_kinship = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_elves.41 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = zin_elves_passes_lost_seen
				any_state = {
					zin_is_site_nolorim_passes = yes
					controller = { zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes }
				}
			}
			clr_global_flag = zin_elves_passes_lost_seen
		}
	}
}

# Run once by the hidden event zin_elves.1: start values, the startup lists of section 2, the level-1 pass forts, the random marchers.
zin_elves_startup = {
	set_variable = { global.zin_elves_kinship = 35 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_elves_rivalry = 45 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_elves_wall_grievance = 25 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_elves_roost_bond = 50 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_elves_pass_fort_level = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_elves_pacts_seen = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_elves_corruptions_seen = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_elves_pass_watch_mirror = 30 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = Y0X }
		Y0X = { set_variable = { zin_elves_pass_watch = 30 } }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes }
		set_variable = { zin_elves_wanderers_out = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_state = {
					any_neighbor_state = { zin_is_site_great_wall = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_elves_wall_realm
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_elves_rift_realm
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					zin_elves_is_wall_realm = yes
					any_owned_state = {
						any_neighbor_state = { is_owned_by = Y8G }
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_elves_pilgrim_realm
			set_variable = { zin_elves_pilgrim_roads = 2 }
			set_variable = { zin_elves_pilgrim_months = 0 }
			add_ideas = zin_elves_pilgrim_roads_open
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { zin_rules_ai_random_elves = yes }
			random = {
				chance = 50
				set_country_flag = zin_elves_ai_marcher
			}
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes }
		zin_elves_refresh_costs = yes
	}
	zin_elves_raise_pass_forts = yes
}

# The monthly runner: drifts of kinship, rivalry, grievance and bond, the counts of Pacts and corruptions, the Refusal sync, pilgrim months, the Kindred, the passes and the eastern check.
zin_elves_monthly = {
	# kinship
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_rivalry value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
		zin_elves_add_kinship = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed } set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.3 }
		zin_elves_add_kinship = yes }
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
				zin_elves_realm_occupied = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.5 }
		zin_elves_add_kinship = yes
	}
	# rivalry
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.3 }
	zin_elves_add_rivalry = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed
			country_exists = Y0V
			country_exists = Y0W
			Y0V = { zin_elves_in_kindred = yes }
			Y0W = { zin_elves_in_kindred = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
		zin_elves_add_rivalry = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { country_exists = Y0V }
				NOT = { country_exists = Y0W }
				AND = {
					country_exists = Y0V
					Y0V = {
						is_subject = yes
						overlord = { NOT = { zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes } }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					country_exists = Y0W
					Y0W = {
						is_subject = yes
						overlord = { NOT = { zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_elves_rivalry = 0 }
	}
	# the Wall grievance
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = Y0L
			Y0L = { check_variable = { var = zin_court_corruption value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_wall_accord_broken }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
		zin_elves_add_wall_grievance = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = Y0L
			Y0L = { check_variable = { var = zin_court_corruption value = 30 compare = less_than } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
		zin_elves_add_wall_grievance = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned } set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -1 }
		zin_elves_add_wall_grievance = yes }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_aurevan_crowned
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_customs_offered }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_elves_customs_offered
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_elves_is_wall_realm = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_elves.9 days = 4 }
		}
	}
	# the roost bond
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { zin_world_is_dragon_keeper = yes zin_elves_tends_roosts = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.5 }
		zin_elves_add_roost_bond = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_elves_roost_sickness
			NOT = { any_country = { zin_world_is_dragon_keeper = yes has_country_flag = zin_elves_roosts_guarded } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
		zin_elves_add_roost_bond = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_pacts = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_corrupt = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { var = zin_world_dragon_pacts value = 0 compare = greater_than } check_variable = { var = zin_world_corrupted_dragons value = 0 compare = greater_than } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_pacts = zin_world_dragon_pacts }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_elves_t_corrupt = zin_world_corrupted_dragons }
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_elves_t_pacts value = global.zin_elves_pacts_seen compare = greater_than } }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_elves_pacts_seen = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
		zin_elves_add_roost_bond = yes
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_elves_t_corrupt value = global.zin_elves_corruptions_seen compare = greater_than } }
		zin_elves_on_dragon_corrupted = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_eindil_dragon_pact
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_eindil_dragon_seen }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_elves_eindil_dragon_seen
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
		zin_elves_add_roost_bond = yes
	}
	# the Refusal, costs, Wanderers, pilgrims
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes }
		zin_elves_sync_refusal = yes
		zin_elves_refresh_costs = yes
		zin_elves_count_wanderers = yes
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_elves_is_pilgrim_road_realm = yes
			check_variable = { var = zin_elves_pilgrim_roads value = 2 compare = equals }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_elves_pilgrim_months = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_elves_pilgrim_months value = 12 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { zin_elves_pilgrim_months = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
			zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
		}
	}
	# the Kindred, the passes, the eastern invasion
	zin_elves_kindred_upkeep = yes
	zin_elves_check_passes_lost = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_invasion_answered }
		}
		zin_elves_on_eastern_invasion = yes
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
			has_war = yes
			has_global_flag = zin_elves_invasion_answered
			any_enemy_country = { capital_scope = { zin_is_region_east_lands = yes } }
		}
		add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_elves_woods_defended days = 45 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_revealed
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_temple_noticed }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_elves_temple_noticed
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_elves.60 days = 2 }
		}
	}
	# the high passes follow the watch; last, the elven trees refresh their layouts (decision E4)
	zin_elves_refresh_passes = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}
